primary_endpoint: final averaged-weight heldout accuracy at update2000
length_endpoint: final averaged-weight accuracy on independent inputs at twice the trained chain length
baselines: Report measured majority and last-input copying on every split; uniform-chain copying succeeds with probability (2P-1)/P^2, not1/P.
exact_checks: For f(a,b)=a^3+ab over each chosen prime, K=exp(2*pi*i*f/p) satisfies K K*=p I.
For every fixed c, adding c to this local transition only multiplies K by a unit scalar.
The single missing-entry opposite-phase fill has lower nuclear norm than the true mixed kernel.
For nonzero a,b, exponent-one division has a rank-one multiplicative-character kernel.
exploratory_comparisons: Mixed versus division at each prime and architecture; no optimizer-success theorem is asserted.
Depth4 versus depth1 at approximately matched parameter counts; report head dimensions and measured time.
Full-table mixed fitting versus heldout learning on the half table.
Same-length and doubled-length chain accuracy as L ranges over1,2,4,8.
Initialization seeds11/17 and predeclared zero-decay or lower-rate controls for mixed P97.
limits: Do not infer a whole-chain flat spectrum from flatness of each local transition.
Do not infer transformer failure from failure of nuclear-norm completion.
Do not infer a necessary layer count or an infinite-length algorithm from the finite cases.
Do not select checkpoints, alter the declared budgets, or drop unsuccessful runs using heldout results.
